description:
`follow-window.sh` of the benchmark-window runner reports the `systemctl --user is-active` state of a unit whose default name is a transient unit of one host, so its status word is meaningless for a runner started from a shell or on another host.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The follower's status word reflects the runner it follows without a host-specific default unit name.
- [hard] REQ-02: The queue-line format and the window protocol are unchanged.
title: Window follower defaults to a host-specific systemd unit
